label: EMULLM
description: Coordination, audio, transcription, and administration infrastructure for Codex/Copilot workers over durable JSONL event streams with HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS parity.
summary: Run the EMULLM server, review its transports, and open its administration console.

mailboxEndpoint.description: ws_collab-compatible mailbox directory served by the embedded EMULLM router (also answers at /emullm/mailbox/mailboxes); sibling routes /messages, /send share the base.

servicesEndpoint.description: Native EMULLM catalog of every HTTP and WebSocket service, including comments, parameters, request bodies, responses, reusable schemas, and the shared worker socket at /emullm/ws.

admin.description: Explicit EMULLM operations-console alias; the primary UI also answers at /emullm.

status.description: Live server status: mode, connected workers, models, and mailbox store health.

restart.description: Loopback-only graceful standalone restart, including resident-servant shutdown and warm reconnect.

shutdown.description: Loopback-only graceful standalone shutdown, including resident-servant cleanup.

plugin-api.note: Compatibility metadata for older plugin consumers. New consumers should read plugin-endpoints; the full route catalog lives at servicesEndpoint.

steps: Install the `emullm` package into the repository .venv.
Install and authenticate GitHub Copilot CLI before creating headless Copilot servants.
Start the standalone server, or set EMULLM_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded to mount it in-process.
Open the administration console and confirm the transports answer.
Stop the standalone EMULLM server (or unset EMULLM_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded and stop the embedded mount).
This is a vendored nested project (its own .git) -- remove its directory entirely to uninstall it, or leave it and just disable scanning it (set scan: disabled in plugins.json).

plugin-init.description: Redirects /emullm to the Workspace Emulation Router plugin.

plugin-lifecycle.note: Runs in the runtimeModes.current selection. Standalone owns its server process and exposes graceful restart/shutdown controls; embedded mounts the router into Workbench and rejects standalone process controls.

admin.description: Primary EMULLM operations console at the plugin prefix root.

adminAlias.description: Explicit administration alias retained for plugin-API disambiguation.

status.description: JSON worker/route/config state (see also /emullm/status for the HTML view).

configSections.description: Validate and atomically update or delete one services, agents, routes, workers, backends, or mock configuration section without replacing unrelated settings.

services.description: Native service catalog with comments, parameter metadata, request schemas, responses, and reusable component schemas.

workerWebSocket.description: Single worker socket; optional worker_id and modelmasks query parameters identify and filter each connection without creating new paths.

headlessCopilots.description: List and manage persistent-session headless Copilot servants; sibling routes create, update, start, stop, restart, reset, delete, and read logs.

headlessCopilotModels.description: List models available to the authenticated Copilot CLI account through the bundled SDK, with an explicit fallback catalog.

models.description: OpenAI-compatible catalog of worker personas, configured simulations, stable worker aliases, and every authenticated Copilot backing model under copilot/<model-id> with capability provenance.

modelConfigurator.description: Models configurator metadata for persisted /v1/models merge overrides, route targets, real backends, and four on-demand Copilot worker slots; PUT saves a model and route edit.

loadCopilotModel.description: Proactively load an exported copilot/<model-id> into a matching, empty, or stopped worker-copilot-5..8 slot.

testMediaSamples.description: List built-in American flag, ascending tones, Twinkle melody, and spoken-phrase attachment samples; sibling GET paths return sample bytes.

chatCompletions.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, including image_url and input_audio base64 media persisted to compact cloud-file metadata for native servant delivery over the worker WebSocket.

agents.description: List configured agents; PUT /emullm/admin/agents/{worker_id}/enabled toggles entries such as Carol.

websocketInventory.description: List active worker, mailbox, and interaction-log WebSockets with endpoint metadata and messages-in/messages-out counters.

modelTestClient.description: Run a cancellable model test with image, audio, video, or arbitrary-file attachments from the admin console; DELETE /emullm/admin/test-chat/{request_id} cancels the server task and active worker request.

restart.description: Gracefully stop resident servants, replace the standalone EMULLM process, and warm/reconnect configured servants.

shutdown.description: Gracefully stop resident servants and shut down the standalone EMULLM process.

plugin-endpoints.note: Process controls are loopback-only and available in standalone mode. /emullm/admin/reset clears persisted data; it does not restart the process.
